records.title: Human-In-The-Loop Permanent Governance and Safeguards
records.content: SupremeAI enforces strict Human-In-The-Loop (HITL) policies for all sensitive, destructive, external, or irreversible actions. Low-risk operations may run automatically, but irreversible state modifications require explicit human authorization and cryptographically logged audit records.

records.title: Chat as Governed Central Control Plane
records.content: Chat operates as the unified control plane for SupremeAI. All tasks, models, memory modules, browsers, and background tools are governed spokes orchestrated through the central chat interface carrying standardized ExecutionRecords.

records.title: Zero-Cost Infrastructure and Free-Tier Optimization
records.content: System architecture is designed for zero infrastructure costs, maximizing free-tier resiliency across Render, Supabase, Cloudflare, and Vercel. Remote persistent storage is delegated to Supabase PostgreSQL (pgvector) without relying on paid persistent disks.

records.title: Learning Flywheel and Provenance-Bearing Records
records.content: Long-term learning is preserved through provenance-bearing records, semantic memory vectors, and offline-evaluated curriculum manifests. Candidate skills and lessons remain quarantined until approved and signed.

records.title: Browser Automation Isolation and SSRF Protection
records.content: Browser automation enforces per-user session isolation, strict anti-SSRF filtering against internal/loopback/cloud metadata IP ranges, and deterministic lifecycle termination on idle or shutdown.
